patterns.note: A full-bleed video hero section with centrally aligned, stacked text creates a dramatic initial impression.
Dramatic, oversized serif headings are paired with a clean, understated sans-serif for body and navigation, creating a high-contrast typographic hierarchy.
A high-contrast color scheme of deep black and warm, light beige is consistently used across sections, accented by subtle gold for interactive elements.
A unique decorative border element transitions from the bottom of the hero to a fixed position below the sticky navigation upon scroll, acting as a persistent visual divider.
A distinct, repeating geometric pattern is used as a visual separator between major content blocks, reinforcing the brand's elegant aesthetic.

technique_notes: A full-bleed video plays in the hero section, serving as a dynamic background for overlaid, centered text, leveraging the 'video-hero' animation tech.
The main navigation bar becomes sticky at the top of the viewport after initial scroll, maintaining its position and accessibility.

A unique decorative border element is initially positioned at the bottom of the hero, then animates to a fixed position directly below the sticky navigation as the user scrolls, acting as a persistent visual divider.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif headings (approx. 4-5x body text) create a dramatic focal point, complemented by smaller, legible sans-serif for navigation and body content.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently used for buttons and overall element edges.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced, with an airy hero section that uses generous negative space around the central text, transitioning to a more standard density in the footer.

standout: The site's standout feature is the dramatic interplay of classic, elegant typography with a dynamic full-bleed video hero and a distinctive, animated decorative border. This combination creates a luxurious and immersive brand experience that feels both modern and timeless.
